questions.question: Why can one fire help a place while another causes lasting harm?
questions.needed: A located fire with observed variation and assessment dates
questions.next: Select reviewed severity and field observations for the pilot

questions.question: Why is there no single treatment for all of Oregon?
questions.next: Check pilot landscape plan and local fire-history research

questions.question: Why burn, thin, protect homes, or sometimes allow wildfire to continue?
questions.needed: Documented alternatives and scopes for one place
questions.next: Obtain pilot decision and community planning documents

questions.question: Why was this location selected before another?
questions.needed: Pilot plan priorities, selection criteria, and revised boundaries
questions.next: Request adopted plan and unit crosswalk; do not infer selection from map overlap

questions.question: Why does approved work not immediately happen?
questions.needed: Dated project schedule, authorizations, staffing and contracts, with reasons for changes
questions.next: Request one existing project timeline from each candidate custodian

questions.question: What does another million dollars buy in this place?
questions.needed: Attributable actual spending, unit costs, ready projects, staffing and procurement constraints
questions.next: Reconcile one award-to-expense-to-work chain before proposing a local expansion

questions.question: How long does the work last, and who pays for maintenance?
questions.needed: Local monitoring and maintenance plan, repeated activities, funding
questions.next: Ask selected custodian for monitoring triggers and maintenance records

questions.question: Why cannot wood sales or energy revenue pay for all the work?
questions.needed: Documented project receipts, removal and transport costs, product markets, smoke and emissions tradeoffs
questions.next: Find a project ledger before making a general economic claim

questions.question: How can researchers estimate damage avoided when the alternative did not happen?
questions.needed: Study populations, counterfactual methods, uncertainty, and replication output
questions.next: Reproduce one published result; seek qualified methods review before local application

questions.question: How do landscape work, home protection, utilities and firefighting compare?
questions.needed: Common period, payer, scope, cost basis, outcomes and distributional effects
questions.next: Start with a comparison framework; do not rank spending without comparable records
